strongs_1890.strongs_def: a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness
strongs_1890.derivation: from H5182 (נְחַת); also (intransitively; perhaps from H5117 (נוּחַ))
strongs_1890.kjv_def: lighting down, quiet(-ness), to rest, be set on.
